# AgentPress Material Kit: Electron: using pepper flash plugin

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/using-pepper-flash-plugin

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for desktop app/security/build docs agents need: using pepper flash plugin

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:

Rules:
